adoption_note: Adopted by the EvE workstream from a0/contract/selection/simpleloop.selection.json. The `scalarization` and `failure_stage_mapping` blocks are copied VERBATIM from it; a0_adapter/selectionmap.py re-derives both blocks' canonical digests at run time, compares them with the frozen values (failure_stage_mapping = 201fed78..., scalarization = d59f0930...) and with this copy, and refuses to report a run in which any of the three disagrees (adapter exit 3). The `selection` block below is EvE's own: EvE does not run an argmax over C* -- its A0.2 semantics are the sampler's, so that block states what the adapter actually observed on the runtime's real machinery.

failure_stage_mapping.note: E* verdict -> trace failure_stage. The trace schema fixes the enum but not this per-runtime mapping; SimpleLoop freezes it here and reports it to the contract owner so the other runtimes can adopt the same one.

scalarization.identity_check: when status == ok the adapter asserts objective.value == fields.sum_radii and fails the candidate otherwise
scalarization.nonfinite: a non-finite scalar (nan/inf) is rejected as an adapter-side measurement error, not compared
scalarization.null_is_not_zero: a null scalar is never coerced to 0.0 or to -inf; an unscored candidate is recorded as unscored and is excluded from the argmax. E* exit 2 / exit 3 propagate as failure_stage values with failure_detail, not as a number.
scalarization.status_gate: scalar is defined iff outcome.status == "ok"; when status is "invalid" or "error" the scalar is null

selection.claim_under_test: position 0 of the rendered order is the draw the runtime consumes as its parent example; the draw's weight is E*'s score through the sampler's own softmax, which is what makes a changed score change the selection (the A0.2 injected-score control).
selection.not_claimed: EvE's shipped loop is a full evolutionary search, not an argmax: the adapter does not claim the frozen SimpleLoop champion rule applies to a real EvE run, only that the sampler under test consumes the score as A0.2 requires.
selection.null_fold: the same `scalarization` block as the other runtimes: a null scalar is never 0.0 or -inf
selection.runtime_machinery: EvE has no argmax over an evaluated pool that the adapter could point at. What A0.2 tests is the runtime's sampler: `loop.sampling.solver_examples` instantiated by Hydra from the shipped config (seam S1, factory.py:291-299), called through the real call site Phase2BatchRunner._sample_solvers with the population's unseeded RNG (S2, phase2.py:597-605), and observed through the {solver_examples_block} order rendered into the Phase-2 README (S3, immutable_renderers/base.py:179-196).
selection.search_signal: F_r(E*) = scalar(E*) = outcome.fields.sum_radii (contract/fr/scalar.json, fr.spec_hash 1fa6f941...), written into the score payload the step emits; EvE reads it with populations/score.py:11-33. E* itself is never scalarized by the runtime.

This file is the runtime-side declaration a0_adapter/selectionmap.py reads at run time; the canonical digests of both shared blocks are recomputed from a0/contract/selection/simpleloop.selection.json and recorded in every A0.1/A0.2 report.
